headline.en: Feyenoord at 18:45 on 9 September opens the league phase
headline.es: El Feyenoord a las 18:45 del 9 de septiembre abre la fase liga
headline.de: Feyenoord um 18:45 am 9. September eroffnet die Liga-Phase
headline.fr: Feyenoord a 18h45 le 9 septembre ouvre la phase de ligue
headline.it: Il Feyenoord alle 18:45 del 9 settembre apre la fase campionato

summary.en: UEFA locked kickoff times on Saturday. Barcelona host Feyenoord at Camp Nou on Wednesday 9 September at 18:45 CET. First of eight league-phase nights. Early slot means less recovery after a Liga weekend. Then Galatasaray away, PSG away, Villa at home, Sabah away, City at home, Sporting away, Como at home with Fabregas. The Clasico is not parked against that first European midweek. Depth is now a calendar problem.
summary.es: La UEFA fijo los horarios el sabado. El Barca recibe al Feyenoord el 9 de septiembre a las 18:45. No es un estreno suave. Luego Galatasaray, PSG, Villa, Sabah, City, Sporting y Como. El Clasico no se cruza con esa primera noche. La profundidad de plantilla pasa a ser calendario.
summary.de: UEFA hat die Zeiten fixiert. Auftakt gegen Feyenoord am 9. September um 18:45. Danach Galatasaray, PSG, Villa, Sabah, City, Sporting, Como. Kaderbreite ist jetzt ein Kalenderproblem.
summary.fr: L'UEFA a fige les horaires. Feyenoord le 9 septembre a 18h45 au Camp Nou. Puis Galatasaray, PSG, Villa, Sabah, City, Sporting, Como. La profondeur devient un sujet de calendrier.
summary.it: La UEFA ha chiuso gli orari. Feyenoord il 9 settembre alle 18:45. Poi Galatasaray, PSG, Villa, Sabah, City, Sporting, Como. La profondita di rosa e diventata calendario.

headline.en: Eric Garcia serves the Metropolitano red against Feyenoord
headline.es: Eric Garcia cumple la roja del Metropolitano ante el Feyenoord
headline.de: Eric Garcia sitzt die Rote vom Metropolitano gegen Feyenoord ab
headline.fr: Eric Garcia purge le rouge du Metropolitano contre Feyenoord
headline.it: Eric Garcia sconta il rosso del Metropolitano col Feyenoord

summary.en: Regulation, not a new incident. UEFA rule 63.01 carries a straight red into the next European match. Garcia was sent off in last season's quarter-final second leg at Atletico, so he misses 9 September. Sole at MD notes the yellow cycle now runs to four cards. That change does not save him. Kounde and Xavi Espart cover the right side. Inconvenient for the first European night, not a system problem unless Liga minutes around that midweek also tighten.
summary.es: Es reglamento. El 63.01 de la UEFA arrastra la roja al siguiente partido europeo. Garcia la vio en la vuelta de cuartos en el Metropolitano y se pierde el 9 de septiembre. El nuevo ciclo de amarillas no le salva. Kounde y Espart cubren la derecha.
summary.de: Vorschrift. Regel 63.01 nimmt die Rote mit. Garcia fehlt am 9. September. Kounde und Espart stehen rechts bereit.
summary.fr: Reglement. L'article 63.01 reporte le rouge. Garcia manque le 9 septembre. Kounde et Espart restent a droite.
summary.it: Regolamento. La 63.01 porta il rosso alla gara successiva. Garcia salta il 9 settembre. Kounde e Espart restano a destra.

headline.en: Livakovic is in the session. The ficha is the real deal
headline.es: Livakovic esta en la sesion. La ficha es el fichaje de verdad
headline.de: Livakovic ist im Training. Die Lizenz ist der eigentliche Deal
headline.fr: Livakovic est dans le groupe. L'inscription est le vrai dossier
headline.it: Livakovic e in seduta. Il tesseramento e l'affare vero

summary.en: Contract through 2030, small fixed fee plus add-ons to Fenerbahce after delayed Turkish paperwork. He trained with the first team on Saturday. That answers the football question. Joan Garcia starts. Szczesny is still there. Whether Livakovic is listed for Liga and UCL or loaned is fair play, not the dinner at Botafumeiro. A fourth goalkeeper only helps if he can be named.
summary.es: Contrato hasta 2030 y cifra baja mas variables al Fenerbahce. El sabado trabajo con el primer equipo. Joan Garcia es titular. Si entra en Liga y Champions o sale cedido lo decide el fair play. Un cuarto portero solo sirve si puede ser convocado.
summary.de: Vertrag bis 2030. Samstag mit der ersten Mannschaft. Joan Garcia bleibt Nummer eins. Liga-Kader oder Leihe hangt am Fair Play.
summary.fr: Contrat jusqu'en 2030. Samedi avec le groupe. Joan Garcia titulaire. Inscription ou pret: le fair-play.
summary.it: Contratto al 2030. Sabato col gruppo. Joan Garcia titolare. Rosa o prestito: fair play.

headline.en: Rodri is being loaded in the gym, not in the full session
headline.es: A Rodri lo cargan en el gimnasio, no en la sesion completa
headline.de: Rodri wird im Gym belastet, nicht in der vollen Einheit
headline.fr: Rodri est charge en salle, pas dans le groupe entier
headline.it: Rodri viene caricato in palestra, non nella seduta intera

summary.en: SPORT from the Ciutat Esportiva: he trained apart again and did gym work on the plan written when he arrived. That is a managed return after a World Cup summer, not a scare. Minutes against Athletic were the first public look. Flick wanted a few minutes next to Pedri. Treating a 2-0 cameo as finished integration is how you lose him in October.
summary.es: SPORT desde la Ciutat: el sabado trabajo al margen y en el gimnasio. No es un susto. Es una reentrada controlada. Los minutos ante el Athletic fueron la primera foto, no la carga cerrada.
summary.de: SPORT: wieder Gym und Individualarbeit. Gesteuerter Wiedereinstieg, kein Schreck. Die Minuten gegen Athletic waren der erste Blick.
summary.fr: SPORT: encore la salle et le travail a part. Remontee controlee, pas une alerte. Les minutes contre l'Athletic etaient la premiere image.
summary.it: SPORT: palestra e lavoro a parte. Rientro guidato, non un allarme. I minuti con l'Athletic erano la prima foto.

tweets.name: Diario SPORT
tweets.text: Rodri continua con su plan especifico. Volvio a entrenarse al margen del grupo.

headline.en: Atletico will not sell Alvarez. The decree is context, not a contract
headline.es: El Atletico no vende a Alvarez. El decreto es contexto, no un contrato
headline.de: Atletico verkauft Alvarez nicht. Das Dekret ist Kontext, kein Vertrag
headline.fr: L'Atletico ne vend pas Alvarez. Le decret est un cadre, pas un contrat
headline.it: L'Atletico non vende Alvarez. Il decreto e contesto, non un contratto

summary.en: The football position has not moved. Atletico will not open talks. Flick, Deco and Laporta already aligned in public. What moved on Saturday is legal colour: Fuentes in MD argues decree 1006 would not automatically punish Alvarez or Barcelona if he forced an exit. Useful if this becomes a dispute. It is not a bid. Arsenal clause talk is discovery, not confirmation. Until Atletico change the sentence, Flick's nine is Raphinha, Ferran and whoever finishes games.
summary.es: El Atletico no abre mesa. Flick, Deco y Laporta ya alinearon. Fuentes (MD) dice que el decreto 1006 no sancionaria de forma automatica. Es marco legal, no operacion. El Arsenal es ruido. El nueve sigue siendo Raphinha y Ferran.
summary.de: Atletico spricht nicht. Fuentes: Dekret 1006 sanktioniert nicht automatisch. Recht, kein Angebot. Der Neuner bleibt Raphinha und Ferran.
summary.fr: L'Atletico n'ouvre pas. Fuentes: le decret 1006 ne sanctionne pas automatiquement. Cadre legal, pas une offre. Le 9 reste Raphinha et Ferran.
summary.it: L'Atletico non apre. Fuentes: il decreto 1006 non sanziona in automatico. Quadro legale, non offerta. Il nove resta Raphinha e Ferran.

tweets.text: El Real Decreto 1.006 no sancionaria ni a Julian Alvarez ni al Barca. @RamonFuentes74

headline.en: Rayo on Monday at 21:30, Gavi held out of the last full session
headline.es: Rayo el lunes a las 21:30, Gavi fuera de la ultima sesion completa
headline.de: Rayo am Montag um 21:30, Gavi fehlt in der letzten vollen Einheit
headline.fr: Rayo lundi a 21h30, Gavi tenu hors de la derniere seance complete
headline.it: Rayo lunedi alle 21:30, Gavi fuori dall'ultima seduta piena

summary.en: Two from two after Elche and Athletic. Monday is Rayo at Camp Nou, 21:30, first midweek Liga night of the title defence. MD training note: Livakovic in, Gavi not, after the knock in Elche. Availability, not drama. Flick is already protecting midfield volume with Pedri, Gavi and Rodri all managed. If the knee tightens overnight, the midfield on 1 September looks thinner than the table.
summary.es: Dos de dos. El lunes Rayo a las 21:30. MD: Livakovic con el grupo, Gavi no, tras Elche. Es disponibilidad. Si la rodilla se carga, el medio del 1 de septiembre se ve mas corto que la clasificacion.
summary.de: Zwei aus zwei. Montag Rayo um 21:30. MD: Livakovic da, Gavi nicht. Verfuegbarkeit, kein Drama.
summary.fr: Deux sur deux. Lundi Rayo a 21h30. MD: Livakovic present, Gavi absent. Disponibilite, pas un drame.
summary.it: Due su due. Lunedi Rayo alle 21:30. MD: Livakovic si, Gavi no. Disponibilita, non dramma.

headline.en: Toni Fernandez to Venezia: cash, sell-on, buy-back
headline.es: Toni Fernandez al Venezia: caja, plusvalia y opcion de vuelta
headline.de: Toni Fernandez zu Venezia: Geld, Weiterverkauf, Rueckkauf
headline.fr: Toni Fernandez a Venezia: cash, clause de revente, rachat
headline.it: Toni Fernandez al Venezia: cassa, percentuale e controriscatto

summary.en: Deco is selling players who are not in Flick's eleven and keeping a string on them. Venezia have a verbal deal for Fernandez around four million. Romano filed the structure: 50 percent of a future sale and a buy-back. He is 18, already a Copa and Liga cameo, last year of his contract. Same lane as Fort and Cortes. Not a first-team story. This is how the next registration gets funded. MARCA's five-million figure is a second number that still needs the contract.
summary.es: Deco vende a quien no esta en el once y deja un hilo. Venezia, acuerdo verbal cerca de cuatro millones. Romano: 50 por ciento de futura venta y recompra. Dieciocho anos, ultimo ano de contrato. Mismo carril que Fort y Cortes. Asi se financia la siguiente ficha.
summary.de: Deco verkauft und behaelt eine Leine. Venezia verbal um vier Millionen. Romano: 50 Prozent plus Rueckkauf. Keine erste Mannschaft. So wird die naechste Lizenz bezahlt.
summary.fr: Deco vend et garde un fil. Venezia autour de quatre millions. Romano: 50 pour cent et rachat. Pas l'equipe premiere. Ainsi se finance la prochaine inscription.
summary.it: Deco vende e tiene un filo. Venezia intorno ai quattro milioni. Romano: 50 per cento e controriscatto. Non e prima squadra. Cosi si finanzia il prossimo tesseramento.

headline.en: Flick is rewriting the press around Raphinha, not around a new nine
headline.es: Flick reescribe la presion con Raphinha, no con un nueve nuevo
headline.de: Flick schreibt das Pressing um Raphinha, nicht um einen neuen Neuner
headline.fr: Flick recrit le pressing autour de Raphinha, pas autour d'un nouveau 9
headline.it: Flick riscrive la pressione su Raphinha, non su un nuovo nove

summary.en: MD's Saturday note is the right read. Small structural changes. Without a classic centre-forward against Elche and Athletic, Raphinha's starting point for the press has moved. He is the reference that tells the line when to jump, not only the wide trigger. That is why Alvarez and Raphinha are two cards. Flick already said the squad is enough if the nine never arrives. Rayo will test the distances on Monday. Garcia also missing midweek in Europe makes those distances less theoretical.
summary.es: La nota de MD es la lectura correcta. Sin un nueve clasico, Raphinha cambia el origen de la presion. Es la referencia, no solo el gatillo abierto. Alvarez y Raphinha no son la misma tarjeta. El Rayo examina las distancias el lunes.
summary.de: MDs Note ist die richtige Lesart. Ohne klassischen Neuner startet Raphinha das Pressing anders. Alvarez und Raphinha sind zwei Karten. Rayo prueft die Abstaende am Montag.
summary.fr: La note de MD est la bonne lecture. Sans vrai 9, Raphinha devient la reference du pressing. Alvarez et Raphinha ne sont pas la meme carte. Le Rayo teste les distances lundi.
summary.it: La nota di MD e la lettura giusta. Senza un nove classico Raphinha e il riferimento della pressione. Alvarez e Raphinha non sono la stessa card. Il Rayo prova le distanze lunedi.
